records.statement: Planets at N days after birth correspond symbolically to age N years.
records.author: Astrodienst FAQ

records.statement: Naibod advances natal ARMC by 0.98564733 degrees per year; solar-arc-MC instead advances ecliptic MC by the progressed Sun arc. Actual secondary rotation uses the sidereal time at the progressed epoch.
records.author: Astrodienst FAQ
records.exception: The first two are directed-angle conventions combined with secondary planets; do not call all planets solar-arc directed.

records.statement: Progressed-to-natal contacts emphasize the natal factor; mutual progressed aspects describe interaction between evolving factors.
The progressed Moon highlights topics of the natal house it traverses. A sign or house ingress is interpreted as an orientation shift.
A progressed solar sign adds a symbolic developmental emphasis; it does not replace the natal Sun sign.
A progressed new Moon symbolizes a new chapter, first quarter a building stage, and full Moon culmination; subsequent waning phases concern release and sharing.

implementation_choices.time_scale: TT for continuous uniform symbolic days; target and birth civil timestamps converted by pinned Skyfield timescale data.
implementation_choices.default_orbs: One degree for each selected major aspect; explicit project configuration, not attributed as universal historical doctrine.

coverage: General documented procedures and compositional symbolism only. Direct progression planet-pair readings are unsupported pending source verification.
rights: Concise original research notes; no books or articles ingested. Some Astrodienst direct links are browser-challenged; indexed text checked.
